verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API that gives programmatic access to all its resources, including feature flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. API tokens for automation are documented, and an llms.txt gives AI agents a machine-friendly entry point to the docs, so an AI-native user can drive the product through a documented public API. Missing for 10: endpoint-level reference detail in the evidence (e.g. an OpenAPI spec), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
The Admin API provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources.
Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.
